passages.title: The Green Leaf
passages.text: A. This cafe is perfect for people who want healthy, organic food. They serve fresh salads, homemade soups, and a variety of herbal teas. It is open for breakfast and lunch only.

passages.title: Pasta Palace
passages.text: B. If you love Italian food, this is the place to be. They offer a wide range of pasta dishes and pizzas at very affordable prices. It is a popular spot for families with children.

passages.title: Burger Stop
passages.text: C. This fast-food restaurant is famous for its giant burgers and thick milkshakes. It is open late every night, making it a great choice for a quick meal after a movie.

passages.title: The Spice Garden
passages.text: D. Experience authentic Indian cuisine in a quiet, elegant setting. Their menu includes many vegetarian options and spicy curries. Booking a table in advance is highly recommended.

passages.title: Coffee Corner
passages.text: E. A cozy spot with comfortable chairs and free Wi-Fi. They serve excellent coffee, cakes, and light snacks. It is the ideal place to study or work on your laptop.

passages.title: Ocean View
passages.text: F. Located right by the beach, this restaurant specializes in fresh fish and seafood. The prices are high, but the view of the sunset makes it worth the cost.

passages.title: The Daily Bread
passages.text: G. This bakery offers freshly baked bread, pastries, and sandwiches. Everything is made on-site every morning. It is a great place to pick up a quick breakfast on your way to work.

passages.title: Sushi World
passages.text: H. Enjoy a unique dining experience where food is served on a moving belt. You can choose from many different types of sushi and sashimi. It is a fun and fast way to eat.

questions.question: Sarah needs a quiet place where she can use her laptop for a few hours while having a drink and a snack.
questions.explanation: Coffee Corner provides comfortable seating, Wi-Fi, and snacks, which is ideal for working.

questions.question: Mark wants to take his family out for a meal that is not too expensive and offers dishes that children usually enjoy.
questions.explanation: Pasta Palace is highlighted as a popular spot for families with affordable prices.

questions.question: Elena is looking for a restaurant that serves healthy, organic food and is only open during the day.
questions.explanation: The Green Leaf focuses on healthy, organic food and is open for breakfast and lunch only.

questions.question: James wants to celebrate his anniversary at a place with a special atmosphere and needs to book a table before going.
questions.explanation: The Spice Garden offers an elegant setting and requires booking in advance.

questions.question: Tom is looking for a quick bite to eat late at night after he finishes watching a film at the cinema.
questions.explanation: Burger Stop is open late every night and is suitable for a quick meal after a movie.
